# Index Rebuild Tests — verify index regeneration from filesystem

# --- Setup: initialize KB and write pages ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
exec akb template get adr --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/adr.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note and adr templates'

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write rebuild-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/rebuild-note.md'

stdin ../note2-input.md
exec akb write another-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/another-note.md'

stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write rebuild-decision.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/rebuild-decision.md'

# --- Rebuild index from filesystem ---

exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

# --- Show index contains entries for all pages ---

exec akb index show
stdout '## Notes'
stdout '## Adrs'
stdout 'Rebuild Note'
stdout 'Another Note'
stdout 'Rebuild Decision'

# --- Entries are under correct type headings ---

exec akb index show
stdout 'rebuild-note.md'
stdout 'another-note.md'
stdout 'rebuild-decision.md'

# --- Rebuild after manual index add preserves all entries ---

exec akb index add kb/notes/rebuild-note.md 'Manual summary'
stdout 'Added kb/notes/rebuild-note.md to index'

# Rebuild regenerates from filesystem, replacing manual entry
exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

exec akb index show
stdout 'Rebuild Note'
stdout 'Another Note'
stdout 'Rebuild Decision'

# --- Rebuild on empty KB produces minimal index ---

exec akb delete notes/rebuild-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/rebuild-note.md'

exec akb delete notes/another-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/another-note.md'

exec akb delete decisions/rebuild-decision.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/decisions/rebuild-decision.md'

exec akb index rebuild
stdout 'Index rebuilt'

exec akb index show
stdout '# Index'
! stdout 'rebuild-note'
! stdout 'another-note'
! stdout 'rebuild-decision'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Rebuild Note
summary: Note for rebuild test
tags: test
---
Note content for rebuild.

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Another Note
summary: Second note for rebuild
tags: test
---
Second note content.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Rebuild Decision
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Decision for rebuild test
tags: [test]
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
## Context

ADR content for rebuild. The rebuild regenerates the index from the filesystem, so the entry for this decision is derived from the page itself rather than from a manual index add. See [[rebuild-note]] for the note that goes through the same rebuild.

## Decision

Decided. The decision keeps the sections and the body the template requires.

## Consequences

Recorded. Deleting the page removes its entry from the regenerated index.
